description: This file defines the Test::Coocook class, a Perl module providing testing utilities for the Coocook application, including email handling, configuration reloading, and web interaction methods.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A Perl testing utility class for the Coocook application, providing methods for email handling, web requests, configuration management, and user interaction testing.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for the Test::Coocook class, initializes environment variables, sets up the object with a Catalyst app, and applies HTML::TreeBuilder::XPath for HTML parsing.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request, optionally logs request and response details if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: emails
methods.description: Returns a list of email deliveries captured during tests.

methods.name: clear_emails
methods.description: Clears stored email deliveries and resets email count.

methods.name: shift_emails
methods.description: Removes and returns a specified number of email deliveries from the stored list.

methods.name: email_count_is
methods.description: Asserts that the number of stored email deliveries matches the expected count.

methods.name: local_config_guard
methods.description: Provides a guard object that restores the original configuration after modifications within its scope.

methods.name: reload_config
methods.description: Reloads the application configuration, either as an instance or class method.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Accesses the database schema via the Catalyst model.

methods.name: register_ok
methods.description: Automates the registration process in tests, verifying successful registration.

methods.name: register_fails_like
methods.description: Tests registration failure scenarios matching a specific error regex.

methods.name: get_ok_email_link_like
methods.description: Finds URLs in email bodies matching a regex and performs GET requests on them, verifying response status.

methods.name: email_like
methods.description: Checks if the first email body matches a regex.

methods.name: email_unlike
methods.description: Checks if the first email body does not match a regex.

methods.name: _email_un_like
methods.description: Internal method to perform email content matching or non-matching assertions.

methods.name: _get_email_body
methods.description: Retrieves the body content of the first stored email.

methods.name: is_logged_in
methods.description: Verifies that the client is logged in by checking page content.

methods.name: is_logged_out
methods.description: Verifies that the client is logged out by checking page content.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with provided credentials.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login and verifies success.

methods.name: login_fails
methods.description: Verifies that login with given credentials fails.

methods.name: logout_ok
methods.description: Performs logout action.

methods.name: change_display_name_ok
methods.description: Changes user display name and verifies success.

methods.name: request_recovery_link_ok
methods.description: Requests a password recovery link and verifies email content.

methods.name: create_project_ok
methods.description: Creates a new project in tests and verifies its presence.

methods.name: checkbox_is_on
methods.description: Asserts that a checkbox input is checked.

methods.name: checkbox_is_off
methods.description: Asserts that a checkbox input is unchecked.

methods.name: _checkbox_is_on_off
methods.description: Internal method to verify checkbox state.

methods.name: input_has_value
methods.description: Verifies that an input element has a specific value.

methods.name: json_is
methods.description: Asserts that the response content decodes to expected JSON.

methods.name: redirect_is
methods.description: Verifies that a GET request redirects to a specific URL with expected status.

methods.name: reload_ok
methods.description: Performs a reload of the page and verifies success.

methods.name: robots_flags_ok
methods.description: Checks the 'robots' meta tag flags in the page content.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Verifies the HTTP response status code.

methods.name: status_like
methods.description: Verifies the response status code matches a pattern.

methods.name: submit_form_fails
methods.description: Submits a form expecting failure (e.g., 400 status).
